title: Không, cảm ơn, tôi sẽ xem xét xung quanh trước
englishTitle: No thank you, I’ll look around first
pronunciation: Khong cam on toi se xem xet xung quanh truoc
summary: Keeps the shopping question clear in a market stall or small shop.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Không, cảm ơn, tôi sẽ xem xét xung quanh trước closes a helpful exchange warmly. It is short enough for a beginner and works after directions, service help, a purchase, or a small kindness.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Không, cảm ơn, tôi sẽ xem xét xung quanh trước as one clean sentence; the item, size, receipt, price tag, or photo can carry the exact detail. Point to the item, menu line, receipt, size, or photo.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: I want this size, Do you have another color, and Can I try this on.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi thử cái này được không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best in a market stall or small shop, before the explanation gets long. Keep the item, size, receipt, price tag, or photo close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: In shops and markets, the object is the reference point. Point to the item, menu line, receipt, size, or photo.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: I’m just looking, Where do I pay, and I want to exchange this.
